items.title: OpenRouter Drops 3 Providers After Researchers Catch Months of Prompt Theft at AI Hosting Firms
items.snippet: Attackers stole data from inside three AI inference providers for months, and none of the three knew until researchers told them, the industrial cybersecurity company Dragos said this week. Some of the stolen requests were flagged as Zero Data Retention, the setting that is supposed to mean a prompt is never stored. Op
items.summary: Dragos says attackers stole data from inside three AI inference providers for months; the providers learned of the theft from researchers.
items.why: Review data-retention claims and access controls at AI inference providers.

items.title: Researchers Demonstrate Ghostscript Sandbox-Escape RCE via Crafted File Uploads in Popular Apps
items.snippet: A now-patched flaw in Ghostscript allows a crafted file to escape the program's security sandbox and run commands on the server that processes it. Ghostscript is the interpreter that many Linux servers use to convert uploaded PDFs, PostScript files, and images into other formats, often without the application calling i
items.summary: Researchers demonstrated a now-patched Ghostscript flaw that let crafted files escape the sandbox and run commands on servers processing them.
items.why: Check Ghostscript versions and isolate services that process uploaded files.

learn.explainer: Zero Data Retention is a stated policy that requests are not retained. The report says some stolen requests were flagged this way, making it useful to distinguish a retention label from whether data was accessed.
Autonomous weapons are weapons whose operation involves autonomy. The item discusses efforts to regulate them through a potential accord.
A naval blockade is a military measure at sea. The Iran articles describe a US naval blockade and discuss its relationship to economic pressure and a possible route to winding down the war.

analysis.headline: Maritime pressure, attacks and rules in focus
paragraphs: The Gulf and Baltic stories describe distinct maritime pressures: the Iran article links attacks with a US naval blockade and sanctions, while the Finland reports concern a drone attack on a Russia-bound ship. Finnish defence forces say Ukraine was likely behind that attack; the supplied reports do not establish responsibility as fact.

The Iran coverage also raises the role of policy choices. One article recalls Congress forbidding Vietnam War funding; another quotes an analyst saying Trump may have to ease the blockade for the war to wind down. Together, these accounts suggest funding and blockade decisions matter to how conflicts are discussed, without establishing what will happen.

The UN story adds a regulatory dimension: CWC countries agreed to elaborate on a potential autonomous-weapons accord in two years, prompting criticism. For analysts, the stories connect operational incidents with economic pressure and debate over rules. Watch how responsibility is attributed, how blockade policy is discussed, and what elaboration on the accord entails.
takeaways: Keep reported attribution of the Baltic attack distinct from established fact.
Track how the Iran blockade appears in accounts of attacks and war-ending options.
Watch for further detail on the proposed autonomous-weapons accord.
